title: Smoky Norwegian Fish Biryani
description: A flavorful and aromatic biryani dish made with Norwegian salmon, mildly smoky spices, and a blend of fresh herbs.

instructions.description: Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger. Cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the smoky biryani masala and mildly smoky paprika. Cook for 1 minute, until the spices are fragrant.
Add the Basmati rice and cook for 2-3 minutes, until the rice is lightly toasted.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the saucepan, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, until the rice is cooked and fluffy.
While the rice is cooking, heat 1 tbsp of oil in a separate pan over medium heat.
Add the Norwegian salmon fillets and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, until cooked through.
To assemble the biryani, add the cooked rice to a serving dish, followed by the cooked salmon fillets.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and a squeeze of lemon juice.
